narrative.overview: Lacquer-black asphalt with one sodium light spent on the time. The visitor sets the minute the car is at the door; car, price, timeline and the mobile bar follow that time.
keyCharacteristics: Giant sodium time dial as the first viewport
Uniform night grading on every photograph

rules.name: Sodium is light
rules.body: Sodium colours numerals, thin edges, states and focus; never a fill.

rules.name: One night
rules.body: Every raster gets the same night grade; daylight frames are cropped or replaced.

rules.name: Light weight, wide face
rules.body: Unbounded only at 300 (500 for the wordmark); emphasis by size and sodium.

dos: Derive every time on the page from the chosen pickup time
Keep all eight cars visible, label self-drive-only
donts: No shadows, rounded corners or filled cards
No eyebrows, testimonial cards or CTA bands
No visible licence plates or daylight photos
